## Appearance

Paul is a boy who previously possessed a halo of naturally curly, chestnut or brown hair, which has since given way to close-cropped brown locks. He has big, very dark, and serious blue eyes. Though he was once very small for his age, by age thirteen he has grown very tall for his years.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), +4 more_

## Personality

A perfect little gentleman, Paul Irving is a clean, manly child who easily holds his own in games. He is also a genius endowed with vivid imagination and occasional flashes of uncanny insight.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054)_

## History

Paul Irving is an imaginative student whose mother died three years prior to his time at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. On his teacher Anne's first day, he cheered her up by gifting her wild orchids, and he later shared written compositions detailing his fantastical imaginary friends. During a walk, Paul shared his thoughts with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his parents, and the two later enjoyed tea together as they discussed his childhood worries and active imagination. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) announced her resignation to attend college, Paul was left distressed by the news. Shortly before Anne's departure, Paul accompanied her to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where he bonded with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people. After his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), returned and reunited with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Paul expressed excitement about their upcoming wedding and his planned move to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +31 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

Paul is a pupil in Anne's schoolroom and quickly becomes a fast friend through their shared love of imaginative ideas. They spend time together chatting over tea and taking long walks, during which Paul opens up about his family and inner thoughts. When news spreads that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is leaving her teaching post to attend college, Paul is deeply distressed by the upcoming loss of his teacher and close companion.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), +11 more_

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)

Paul and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) share a tense dynamic rooted in Davy's intense rivalry and jealousy over [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
